# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 2 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** The Arrogant Conqueror and God's Judgment

---

**2:1** In his arrogance the sinner broke down the strong walls,
and you did not prevent him, O God.

**2:2** Alien nations ascended your altar;
they trampled it arrogantly with their sandals.

**2:3** Because the sons of Jerusalem had defiled the holy things of the LORD,
had profaned the offerings of God with their iniquities.

**2:4** Because of this God said: 'Away from me with these things';
his glory was not honored among them.

**2:5** The children of Jerusalem had despised the holy things of God;
they shamed the offerings of the LORD with their lawless deeds.

**2:6** Therefore God declared: 'Put these far from me;
they have not honored my holiness.'

**2:7** He stood proudly on their heights
and did not spare.

**2:8** He battered down their walls;
God, you did not prevent him.

**2:9** Alien nations went up to your altar;
they trod it down with their sandals in contempt.

**2:10** Because the sons of Jerusalem had defiled the sanctuary of the LORD,
had profaned the holy things of God.

**2:11** He led away their sons and daughters into hard captivity,
their neck in a yoke, a spectacle among the nations.

**2:12** According to their sins God dealt with them;
he abandoned them into the hands of those who prevailed over them.

**2:13** He turned his face from pitying them;
young man and maiden went away into captivity.

**2:14** In the beauty of their youth they went as prisoners before the enemy;
and I said to the LORD God:

**2:15** 'Be righteous in all your judgments, O Lord;
for your righteousness is established forever.'

**2:16** For your judgments extend over all the earth in equity;
all who do not know you are corrected by your hand.

**2:17** You have tested us as silver is tested in the furnace,
you have examined our hearts and our minds.

**2:18** You stretched out your hand over us
and saved us from those who oppressed us.

**2:19** You have lit our lamp, O LORD our God;
our feet walk in your paths of righteousness.

**2:20** We call upon the name of the LORD forever;
let the nations know that God is over Israel.

**2:21** For I saw him raise his hand against the holy city
with arrogance and contempt.

**2:22** He killed their sons and shamed their daughters;
he shed innocent blood as water around Jerusalem.

**2:23** He carried away the young men into captivity
and the daughters of Jerusalem into defilement.

**2:24** He mocked them before the nations;
but God repaid the sinners according to their deeds.

**2:25** He shamed the body of God's anointed;
he shed that blood with arrogant hands.

**2:26** Then God revealed the sins of the arrogant one before all the earth;
he exposed him before all peoples.

**2:27** He struck him down on the rocks of Egypt —
a disgrace exceeding all the disgraces of Egypt.

**2:28** His body was tossed about upon the waves in great contempt;
and there was none to bury him, for God had rejected him.

**2:29** He never considered that he was only a man
nor reflected on his latter end.

**2:30** He said: 'I will be lord of land and sea' —
nor did he consider that God is great,
mighty in his great power.

**2:31** He is the king of the heavens,
who judges kings and powers.

**2:32** He lifts me up to glory
and brings the arrogant down to eternal ruin.

**2:33** As for me, I will call upon the mighty God,
with a heart full of praise.

**2:34** I will praise you, O God, among the assembly of the poor;
for you are the joy and crown of all who fear you.

**2:35** Blessed be the glory of the LORD,
for his judgments are righteous and holy.

**2:36** For he shows mercy to his servants
and pity to the humble.

**2:37** Blessed is the one who fears the LORD;
he shall be delivered by the hand of God.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering integrating EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. Preferred readings noted where agents diverge.*
